verdict.rationale: Supabase's first-party docs describe using database introspection to generate type-safe API definitions and producing a `database.types.ts` file from the project schema. The MCP server also exposes a `generate_typescript_types` tool, so agents can trigger type generation programmatically. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that type generation works, documentation of the exact CLI workflow or automation (e.g. regenerating on migration), evidence of typed output for languages beyond TypeScript.
